title: CliErrorEnvelope
description: The one JSON line the public `grid` CLI writes on stderr when a `--json` command fails. Under `--no-wake` (`grid models | engines | stats`, from 0.3.49) the overview and discovery go out with no credential, an owner status already `asleep` is answered with no request at all, and `code` is `grid_asleep` when the proxy said so and null for every other refusal. A `grid` older than 0.3.49 exits 2 at argparse before it sends anything; a caller reads that as "no read" and must never retry without the flag, which would be a wake. Accepted and ignored in local mode.

status.description: The HTTP status behind the refusal, when there was one.
